// Scratch generator of the measure-units*.json fixtures, not built by this repo. From a detached acr
// worktree at 4eb93cf9: add the first file below as internal/contextfabric/zz_units_export.go and the
// second as cmd/zzunits/main.go, then `go run ./cmd/zzunits <this directory>`.

// internal/contextfabric/zz_units_export.go
package contextfabric

// Scratch only (CHAOS-12570, CHAOS-12571), never committed: the two steps finalizeResult runs before
// shape selection (chaos4636_answer_plan.go), from the real fact declarations.
func ZZWithDeclared(result InvestigationResult, capabilities []FactCapability) InvestigationResult {
	result.ClaimedFacts = withDeclaredMeasureUnits(result.ClaimedFacts, declaredMeasureUnitsOf(capabilities))
	result.ClaimedFacts = withDeclaredCadence(result.ClaimedFacts, declaredCadenceOf(capabilities))
	return result
}

// cmd/zzunits/main.go
// Scratch generator (CHAOS-12570, CHAOS-12571), never committed. From a detached acr worktree at
// 4eb93cf9 with internal/contextfabric/zz_units_export.go beside it: `go run ./cmd/zzunits <dir>`.
// The contract example, through the real declared units and cadence (the producers' own
// declarations, via devhealthfacts.NewProviders), SelectRenderShapes, ServeVocabularyLabels,
// Validate and json.Marshal.
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"

	"github.com/full-chaos/dev-health-acr/internal/contextfabric"
	"github.com/full-chaos/dev-health-acr/internal/contextfabric/devhealthfacts"
)

const maxBytes = 262144

func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}

func load() contextfabric.InvestigationResult {
	raw, err := os.ReadFile("contracts/examples/v1/context_fabric_investigation_result_render_shapes.v1.json")
	must(err)
	var result contextfabric.InvestigationResult
	must(json.Unmarshal(raw, &result))
	return result
}

var frame = &contextfabric.QuestionFrame{SubjectExpression: contextfabric.SubjectExpression{
	Kind:       contextfabric.SubjectExpressionDiscoveredKind,
	Discovered: &contextfabric.DiscoveredSetExpression{MemberKind: contextfabric.SubjectTeam},
}}

func select_(result contextfabric.InvestigationResult) contextfabric.InvestigationResult {
	result.RenderShapes = nil
	result.RenderShapes, _ = contextfabric.SelectRenderShapes(result, frame)
	result.Completeness = contextfabric.ComputeAnswerCompleteness(result)
	return result
}

func main() {
	out := os.Args[1]
	var capabilities []contextfabric.FactCapability
	for _, provider := range devhealthfacts.NewProviders(nil) {
		capabilities = append(capabilities, provider.Capability())
	}
	declared := select_(contextfabric.ZZWithDeclared(load(), capabilities))
	// The example's commits claim, about a repository instead of a project: the repository's own
	// daily_metrics declaration then states its unit and cadence.
	repository := load()
	for index := range repository.ClaimedFacts {
		fact := &repository.ClaimedFacts[index]
		if fact.ClaimID == "claim_metrics_ask_dev_commits" {
			fact.Subject = contextfabric.SubjectRef{Kind: contextfabric.SubjectRepository, CanonicalID: "repository:full-chaos/ask-dev", Label: "full-chaos/ask-dev"}
		}
	}
	repository.SubjectResolution.Committed = append(repository.SubjectResolution.Committed, contextfabric.SubjectRef{Kind: contextfabric.SubjectRepository, CanonicalID: "repository:full-chaos/ask-dev", Label: "full-chaos/ask-dev"})
	repositoryDeclared := select_(contextfabric.ZZWithDeclared(repository, capabilities))
	undeclared := select_(contextfabric.ZZWithDeclared(load(), nil))
	cases := []struct {
		name   string
		result contextfabric.InvestigationResult
		labels bool
	}{
		{"measure-units", declared, true},
		{"measure-units-labels-off", declared, false},
		{"measure-units-undeclared", undeclared, true},
		{"measure-units-repository", repositoryDeclared, true},
	}
	for _, c := range cases {
		served, tier := contextfabric.ServeVocabularyLabels(c.result, c.labels, maxBytes)
		must(served.Validate())
		encoded, err := json.MarshalIndent(served, "", "    ")
		must(err)
		must(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, c.name+".json"), append(encoded, '\n'), 0o644))
		fmt.Printf("%-26s tier=%s shapes=%d bytes=%d\n", c.name, tier, len(served.RenderShapes), len(encoded))
	}
}
